rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Antique & Temple Work
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Traditional temple jewelry, handcrafted filigree, antique deity motifs and repousse craft.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Diamond & Prong Setting
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Precision microscope prong, pave, channel, bezel setting for certified Solitaires and melee diamonds.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Plain Gold & Machine Casting
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Lost-wax vacuum casting, CNC plain gold rings, CAD rapid prototyping assembly.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Kundan & Meenakari
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Pure 24K foil Jadau kundan setting, reversible enameling, jaali backdrop and champlevé crafts.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Stone Setting & Polishing
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Collet mounting of precious gems (Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire), mirror buffing, rhodium flash.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Hand Engraving & Filigree
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Fine silver/gold wire twining, granular openwork, burin hand-chiseled crests and calligraphy.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Choker & Bridal Sets
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Heavy bridal necklaces, multi-strand haar, custom choker frames and flexible torque hinges.

rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.name: Chain & Hollow Bangles
rudra_jewellery.work_specifications.description: Machine and handmade link chains, hollow kadas, tube bending and invisible clasp locks.
